text: In its original formulation, the Univalence Axiom is constructive and carries computational content on its own.
explanation: False: the chapter says HoTT with Univalence is 'not constructive in original formulations - Univalence is an axiom with no computational content.' Cubical type theory (Cohen-Coquand-Huber-Mortberg, 2016) was created precisely to make Univalence derivable and computational via an interval type.
